title: Edge cookies and site sessions
whyItMatters: Cookie values can still open sites the person stayed signed into, including Microsoft, work and shopping accounts, without needing the password.
source: Chromium cookie store layout under User Data/<profile>/Network (Edge follows Chromium): https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/
notes: Older Edge builds stored User Data/*/Cookies directly; check both. Looked for on this PC: exists.

steps: In Edge, open Settings > Privacy, search, and services and clear cookies and other site data.
Delete the cookies file named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Signs you out of sites in Edge on this PC and clears site preferences; synced data can return until sync is turned off.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Manage cookies in Microsoft Edge: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/edge/manage-cookies-in-microsoft-edge-view-allow-block-delete-and-use
